data.name: Audre
data.gender_notes: Audre is used as a unisex name in Christian naming traditions.
data.long_meaning: Derived from the Greek word audē, meaning 'daring' or 'bold'. In Christian tradition, represents the audacity to follow one's faith and trust in God. The name Audre carries the meaning “Noble audacity” and is chosen by families in Christian traditions for the positive qualities it expresses. Linguistically it belongs to the Biblical tradition and is also used in English, Greek, Latin. Parents who choose Audre usually hope their child will grow to embody noble audacity and live with faith, good character and purpose.
data.spiritual_meaning: Audre embodies the courage to pursue spiritual growth and trust in divine guidance.
data.etymology: Audre belongs to the Biblical linguistic tradition and is used in Christian naming. Its recorded meaning is “Noble audacity.”
data.numerology_meaning: In Pythagorean numerology the letters of Audre total 4, giving a life-path number of 4. Number 4 is linked with Rahu and with the qualities of stability, discipline and hard work.

in_hebrew.name: אודרה
in_hebrew.meaning: אודרה - שמעיה, מקשיבה, או שמעת ה', נובעת מהמילה העברית
in_hebrew.long_meaning: אודרה מקורה בשורש העברי שמע, שפירושו לשמוע או להקשיב. השם אודרה קשור ליכולת של שמיעה וקבלה של דברי ה'. השם מופיע ברשימות שמות שונים של נשים בתקופה המקראית, אך לא כתוב שם מפורש במקרא עצמו. האטימולוגיה של השם מחוברת לשמיעה, האזנה, וקבלת המסרים הרוחניים.

in_greek.name: Αυδρή
in_greek.meaning: Αυδρή - αντλ. από το Εβραϊκό, σχετίζεται με την ακοή
in_greek.long_meaning: Το όνομα Αυδρή προέρχεται από την εβραϊκή γλώσσα και σχετίζεται με την έννοια της ακοής ή της ακρόασης. Στην παράδοση της Εκκλησίας, τα ονόματα που προέρχονται από την εβραϊκή γλώσσα συχνά έχουν βαθύ πνευματικό νόημα. Η Αυδρή συνδέεται με την ικανότητα να ακούει και να ανταποκρίνεται στα μηνύματα του Θεού.

in_latin.name: Audrea
in_latin.meaning: Audrea - derived from Hebrew, meaning hear or listener
in_latin.long_meaning: The name Audrea, a variant of Audre, originates from the Hebrew root 'shamah', meaning to hear. This name was adopted into Latin and used within Christian communities to signify a person dedicated to listening to or hearing God's word. The name carries connotations of spiritual attentiveness and obedience.

in_english.name: Audre
in_english.meaning: Audre - means noble, strength, or heard by God in Christian context
in_english.long_meaning: The name Audre is derived from Hebrew origins, specifically from the word 'shamah', which means 'to hear'. In Christian tradition, Audre symbolizes a person who is heard by God or a noble listener. The name carries a spiritual significance, reflecting the virtues of attentiveness, piety, and a strong connection to divine guidance. Historically, the name has been used across various Christian cultures, symbolizing humility and devotion.

data.cultural_impact: The name Audre carries a sense of fearlessness and confidence, which can inspire individuals to boldly pursue their dreams and goals. While the name has no direct historical or denominational connection to Christianity, its bold and audacious connotations may resonate with those who are committed to living a courageous and unwavering faith.
data.spiritual_significance: In the Christian tradition, the name Audre holds spiritual significance as an reminder of the audacity required to trust in God and follow His will, even in the face of adversity or uncertainty. This name may serve as an inspiration for those who seek to live a life of faith and trust, reminding them of the courage and strength they can draw from their devotion to God.
data.spiritual_symbolism: Audre: The audacious spirit of Audrey, a strong and bold woman of faith. Inspired by St. Audrey, who faced persecution with unwavering devotion.

biblical_reference.note: Though not directly mentioned in the Bible, the name's root is connected to biblical concepts of hearing and spiritual listening.
